_metadata.source: SSA, 'Cost-of-Living Increase and Other Determinations for 2026', 90 FR 49047 (November 3, 2025); resource limits per 20 CFR 416.1205 and POMS SI 01110.003
_metadata.verification_note: Federal benefit rates ($994 / $1,491 / $498), the student earned income exclusion and SGA are transcribed from 90 FR 49047. Resource limits and income exclusions are statutory (20 CFR 416.1205, 416.1112, 416.1124).

notes: Federal SSI only: state supplementary payments are not modeled.
In-kind support and maintenance and deeming from an ineligible spouse or parent are not modeled.
The $20 general exclusion applies to unearned income first; any unused part applies to earned income (20 CFR 416.1124(c)(12), 416.1112(c)(4)).
